To: epic:#34659#1 (triage#1)
Routing · eval-run record #34842 · 2026-11-17T13:08Z

The first full round of the published skills' eval cases ran through #34764's runner (draft PR #34841), under ruling 6946545946 (「A 进本仓带全分,同场景卡」). Results: with-skill 144/209 (69%), no-skill 20/209 (10%). The record lists the 65 failing with-skill cases with their missed or forbidden tokens, and the raw records are in the project files under `issue-34764/skill-evals-2026-11-17/`.

The seat routes the 65 failures to `domain:skills` for cards. Filing is yours, not the seat's: the seat does not draft child cards. Cutting them per bundle (the record's table has 11 rows) reads right, but it is your call. Two notes for the filing:

- The 34 objectui verdicts were regraded, because Claude Code 2.1.326 leaves `user-invocable: false` skills off the init-line skills list; the runner handles this. Any card for objectui should cite the regraded verdict.
- "No-skill beat with-skill" appears once (objectstack-data). That row is the most direct evidence that a skill text misleads, so it is worth its own card.

#34842 is a record, not a work card. Please close it once the cards are cut, or exclude `eval-run` from the triage scan, so it does not reappear as unrouted.
